items.name: Bastard sword
items.description:
- **Range:** Close (5 ft.)
- **Versatile (V):** May be used one- or two-handed (higher die with two hands).
- **Heavy (2 slots):** Occupies 2 gear slots.

items.name: Crossbow
items.description:
- **Range:** Far (within sight)
- **Two-Handed (2H):** Must be used with two hands.
- **Loading (L):** Must forgo moving to reload.

items.name: Dagger
items.description:
- **Range:** Close (melee) / Near (thrown)
- **Finesse (F):** May use STR or DEX when attacking.
- **Thrown (Th):** May throw the weapon to make a ranged attack using STR.
